test_minimal_25_9_spark25_leftY.source:
test "test_minimal_25_9_spark25_leftY"

device "FALCON 9"
device "lmtSw0"
device "SPARKMAX/NEO 25"

main:
	set "FALCON 9".output_percent_cmd = 0.15

	set "SPARKMAX/NEO 25".output_percent_cmd = 0.15

	abort "SPARKMAX/NEO 25".current_actual > 40
	abort "FALCON 9".current_actual > 40

	success lmtSw0.pressed
	until timer.elapsed >= 6.0

	# verify that the motor actually moved
	require "SPARKMAX/NEO 25".position_delta outside -1.0 1.0
	require "FALCON 9".position_delta outside -1.0 1.0

	# fail if the limit switch was not pressed during the test
	require lmtSw0.pressed

	require "FALCON 9".current_actual > 0.0

close:

newTests_123.source:
test "newTests_123"

device "SPARKMAX/NEO 25"
device "FALCON 9"
device "controller0"
device "pdp"
device "lmtSw0"
device "pigeon 2"
device "cancoder"
device "roborio"


main:
	set "SPARKMAX/NEO 25".output_percent_cmd = controller0.leftY deadband 0.08 scaled 0.25 default 0.0
	set "FALCON 9".output_percent_cmd = 0.333

	until timer.elapsed >= 10.0
	until lmtSw0.pressed == true

	abort pdp.channel0_current > 10.0
	abort "roborio".input_voltage < 11.0

	require pdp.channel0_fault == false
	require "FALCON 9".current_actual_max > 0.1
	require "SPARKMAX/NEO 25".current_actual_max > 0.1
	require "pigeon 2".yaw_delta_max_abs > 5.0
#	require "cancoder".position_delta_max_abs > 5.0
	require "roborio".input_voltage > 11.5
    	require "roborio".brownout == false
    	require "roborio".rail_6v_enabled == true

pigeon2_yaw_static_sanity.source:
test "pigeon2_yaw_static_sanity"

device "pigeon 2"
init:
    clear "pigeon 2".faults

main:
    until timer.elapsed >= 8.0
    require "pigeon 2".yaw_delta_max_abs > 5.0
    require "pigeon 2".angular_velocity_z < 2.0
    require "pigeon 2".accel_z > 0.7
    require "pigeon 2".supply_voltage > 10.0
    require "pigeon 2".faults == false
